featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey Snehal, 

Thanks for taking the time out to leave us a feedback. We wholly apologise for the experience you had to go through at our studio, though i cross checked with our team mates about such incidence and i could not get a positive revert about such instance.  
Yet considering you had to face some disgusting behaviour we apologise for the same.

About the fee structure 3 months , 6months & Yearly fee payment system is what we follow due to our past experiences. This institute being on 12th Year we had to face a-lot defaulters in terms of Monthly Fee payment due to which we had to face huge losses. That’s when we came up with above given pattern past 1.5 yrs. 
I am sure it would have been explained to you too , as we do explain it to all our clients during enquiry.

This institute also take sessions for financially abled/challenged kids for free or at minimalistic fee structure with no pressure on parents. We also sponsor teeshirts and shoes to such kids.

Being into commercial business also serving 7-8 team mates, with all the overhead expenses, it needs respectable profits for the survival of the institute, that’s what we charge mam. 

Also let us know if you have any financial crisis or any sort of issues we would surely consider that and make decisions accordingly.

We would love if you know us better in future and come across with a positive  approach. Kindly give us an opportunity for the same. Your feedback is very important to us and we will exhaust all measures to make things right. Kindly reach out to us directly on 7507066444 with your feedback , questions and concerns


Thank You
